summary: OpenSSL PKCS#12 NULL pointer dereference in versions 3.0.0 through 3.0.12
details: A NULL pointer dereference in the PKCS#12 parsing code can cause a denial of service when parsing malformed PKCS#12 bundles. Fixed in OpenSSL 3.0.13.

summary: zlib memory corruption when inflating certain crafted deflate streams
details: zlib before 1.2.12 mishandles deflate stream state, allowing a buffer overflow in zlibinflateGetHeader(). Fixed in 1.2.12.
A use-after-free in the busybox awk interpreter can crash the process when processing crafted awk programs. Fixed in busybox 1.36.1.

summary: Terrapin: SSH prefix truncation weakness (strict KEX)
details: A machine-in-the-middle attacker can strip initial handshake messages, downgrading the integrity of the SSH channel. libssh2 before 1.11.1 does not enforce strict KEX. Fixed in 1.11.1.
